title: OptiMizaPion
description: This modpacks contains better performance and some useful utils, it doesn't have any unnecessary mods (maybe)
body:
This modpack that contains optimization mods. I tested it on my integrated graphics laptop, and for the first time I could even play with shaders without turning the game into a slideshow! (MINIMAL shaders were tested)
The modpack improves performance and also includes useful utilities (only useful) such as a minimap and better food stats, quitting without waiting to world saves etc. And it doesn`t have any cosmetic, unnecessary or too heavy mods.
Client with this mods can be played on Vanilla severs
**But, if you are playing with the Create mod, remove ScalableLux.**
The modpack is compatible with most popular mods.
Total weight of mods: 53.1 MB
Without utilities: 38.2 MB
(on 720p resolution, I played with Make Up Ultra Fast with 45 - 50 fps with 8 chunks render distance and custom "medium low" settings! 1.21.11)
